name: Persian Origins — Bilingual Content
author: Arash Javadi
description: English and Persian versions of every page, post and category, switched instantly on the public site, with a light/dark theme, per-language fonts, text size controls, a category grid and a continue-reading button.

retains: Category names and descriptions in other languages stay under Settings → Translations (core's rwp_translations), where core widgets and archive titles read them.
Category images stay in the Media Library; only the link from a category to its image is removed.
Fonts in plugins/persian-origins/assets/fonts are removed with the plugin folder, not by the data wipe.
